answer: Unrepeatable challenge-response beacon. Each agent identity must answer a randomized liveness challenge derived from a shared public randomness beacon, and the reply must embed a fresh nonce derived from current ledger state plus the agent's own prior output. Correct replies form a trellis of linked proofs: a copied answer fails because the nonce chain diverges. Enrollment also requires committing unique compute, measured as verified timber — a fixed quantity of burned CPU time per identity. An attacker farming N sybils pays N times the compute cost and still cannot reuse any prior reply.
